bio: Antonino Colosimo and his wife Angila Vaccaro were the parents of Antonio Colosimo, who was baptized at San Mango di Aquino on 15 June 1659. Antonino's burial was recorded there on 7 January 1673. He is John's 10th-great-grandfather.

summary: Husband of Angila Vaccaro and father of Antonio Colosimo, buried at San Mango di Aquino in 1673; John's 10th-great-grandfather.
